title: payload for capability unit.map.import
description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

check.description: print the concrete replacement diff and write nothing

file.description: reviewed study-map YAML file for this unit (bytes bound by --file-sha256)

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact study-map file bytes approved for import

intentional_reorder.description: reviewed reason for changing the relative order of surviving stages

intentional_state_reset.description: reviewed reason for discarding preserved stage and map state

replace.description: replace the unit's current study map (learner state is carried forward); required when one exists

retire_reason.description: reviewed disposition for the evidence of every retired stage

retire_stage.description: acknowledge one stage this revision removes (repeatable)
